result:
I fixed it: saving workspace settings now changes only the settings that were submitted. Type-checking shows no errors in the organization code, and all 617 tests pass. I didn't add a test for this particular bug.

**Cause:** the settings rules gave every setting a default, and in the validation library this app uses (zod 4) those defaults are filled in even for settings left out of a save. So any save quietly added the missing settings at their defaults: digest at 07:00 UTC, two-factor off, no feature switches. The server re-checked the saved settings against the full rules too, which filled the same defaults again. Both admins' reports come from this.

**Changes:**
- **`src/schemas/organization.ts`**: added `organizationSettingsPatchSchema`, a version of the rules for saves that has no defaults. It keeps the same checks, e.g. the digest hour must be 0–23. `updateOrganizationSchema` now uses it. The full `organizationSettingsSchema` still has its defaults for new workspaces.
- **`src/server/services/organization-service.ts`**: the server re-checks saved settings with the new patch rules instead of the full ones.
- **`src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts`**: when merging a save into the stored settings, a key sent with no value is ignored and can't wipe the stored setting. Values sent on purpose still take effect, including `0`, `false` and `[]`.

A rename sends no settings, so it can no longer change any. I didn't find anything that lets one workspace's save change another's; each update is limited to that workspace's own record.
